description: Source code for media rendering using Windows Media Foundation in Chromium, including functions for converting video rotation, color space, and creating media types for video streams, with support for Dolby Vision and platform-specific configurations.

classes.name: MediaFoundationVideoStream
classes.description: Main class for handling media stream creation and configuration using Media Foundation.

classes.name: MediaFoundationH264VideoStream
classes.description: Specialized class for H264 video stream handling.

classes.name: MediaFoundationHEVCVideoStream
classes.description: Specialized class for HEVC video stream handling.

methods.name: VideoRotationToMF
methods.description: Converts custom VideoRotation enum to Media Foundation rotation format.

methods.name: VideoPrimariesToMF
methods.description: Converts VideoColorSpace primary ID to Media Foundation primaries.

methods.name: VideoTransferFunctionToMF
methods.description: Converts VideoColorSpace transfer ID to Media Foundation transfer function.

methods.name: CustomVideoPrimaryToMF
methods.description: Converts color volume metadata to Media Foundation custom video primaries.

methods.name: GetDolbyVisionConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves Dolby Vision profile string and NALU type based on profile.

methods.name: MakeOffset
methods.description: Creates an MFOffset from a float value.

methods.name: GetVideoType
methods.description: Creates and configures an IMFMediaType based on VideoDecoderConfig.
